title: AA alkaline battery (LR6)
subtitle: 1.5 V alkaline cell · 14.2 mm × 50.3 mm · bobbin construction

parts.name: Steel can (+)
parts.info: Deep-drawn steel can that holds the cell and is its positive current collector: the cathode is pressed against its inside wall. Its open bottom is crimped over the nylon seal.
parts.material: Nickel-plated steel, about 0.25 mm wall, graphite-coated inside

parts.name: Label sleeve
parts.info: Printed shrink-film sleeve that insulates the can, so only the two terminals are live, and carries the branding and warnings.
parts.material: PVC or PET shrink film, about 0.08 mm

parts.name: Positive terminal (+)
parts.info: The raised button at the top. It is part of, or welded to, the can, so it is connected to the cathode.

parts.name: Cathode rings (MnO2)
parts.info: Four pressed rings of manganese dioxide mixed with graphite for conductivity. During discharge the MnO2 is reduced, taking up the electrons that return through the can.
parts.material: Electrolytic manganese dioxide, graphite, KOH electrolyte

parts.name: Separator
parts.info: A porous paper and polymer tube with a closed bottom, soaked in electrolyte. Hydroxide ions pass through it, but it stops the zinc and the manganese dioxide from touching and short-circuiting.

parts.name: Zinc anode gel
parts.info: Zinc powder suspended in a potassium hydroxide gel fills the core. The zinc oxidizes as the cell discharges, releasing the electrons that leave through the negative end.
parts.material: Zinc powder, KOH electrolyte, gelling agent

parts.name: Brass collector nail
parts.info: A brass nail pushed up into the zinc gel. It carries electrons from the anode to the negative end cap it is welded to.

parts.name: Nylon seal and vent
parts.info: Plastic plug that closes the bottom of the can and insulates the negative cap from it. A thin section works as a safety vent that ruptures if gas pressure builds up.

parts.name: Negative end cap (−)
parts.info: The flat negative terminal. Welded to the collector nail and held in place, insulated from the can, by the crimped seal.

notes: Typical bobbin construction; the exact layout varies by manufacturer.
IEC 60086 limits for LR6: at most 14.5 mm diameter and 50.5 mm height.
